capabilities: Encrypts note contents, attachments and paths on the client before upload
Syncs vault files across paired devices through a self-hosted server
Stores version history of encrypted objects on the server
Produces conflict copies and performs three-way text merging
Pairs and revokes devices with pairing codes and a passphrase
extras: Early-development single-user project: test with a separate vault and keep independent backups. No developer-operated service or subscription; you provide hosting, storage and a domain. The current plugin interface is in Chinese. Community plugin code and settings sync is enabled by default on new servers and can be disabled or filtered in the web admin.
problem: Syncing a vault across devices without handing note contents and paths to a hosted service means setting up encryption and a server yourself.
summary: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted vault sync with version history, device pairing, conflict copies and three-way merging.
